neon_city.ev.omen.text: Your deck picks up a clean carrier wave from a station that has not broadcast in years, and for a whole day the odds feel tilted your way.
neon_city.ev.hard.text: The meters run high, the clinics run short, and every favor costs double. The city grinds and takes its cut out of your hide.
neon_city.ev.dread.text: You start hearing the dead zone in your sleep: a low hum under everything, patient, like a name being spelled out one letter at a time.
neon_city.ev.bounty.text: A credit chit turns up in a jacket you bought secondhand, still loaded, no name on it. Small luck, and you take it without asking.
neon_city.ev.weariness.text: Too many nights on the Spine, too many shifts stacked end to end. Your hands slow before your mind admits it.
neon_city.beh.care.1: Seals your wound with a soldering iron
neon_city.beh.care.1.res: The burn closed you; you still smell it when it rains.
neon_city.beh.care.2.res: Your blood stopped running, and your hands shook for a day.
neon_city.beh.care.3: Sits up with you through the fever
neon_city.beh.care.3.res: Someone kept the light on until your fever broke.
neon_city.beh.meal.1: Slides you a bowl of synth-noodles
neon_city.beh.meal.1.res: A cheap bowl, hot and salty, and exactly what you needed.
neon_city.beh.meal.2: Leaves protein bricks at your door
neon_city.beh.meal.2.res: You ate without tasting, and kept working.
neon_city.beh.meal.3.res: You shared a ration that was not enough for one.
neon_city.beh.coin.1.res: Your account stopped screaming, for now.
neon_city.beh.coin.2.res: A debt left your name and landed on theirs.
neon_city.beh.coin.3: Covers a month of rack rent
neon_city.beh.coin.3.res: Your rack stayed yours for another cycle.
neon_city.beh.talk.1: Shoots the shit at the noodle stall
neon_city.beh.talk.1.res: Idle talk loosened the knot in your chest.
neon_city.beh.talk.2: Trades rumors at the transit stop
neon_city.beh.talk.2.res: You learned which way the wind is blowing.
neon_city.beh.talk.3: Talks with you until the rain stops
neon_city.beh.talk.3.res: By the time the rain stopped, you were less alone.
neon_city.beh.teach.1.res: You learned to keep your deck honest.
neon_city.beh.teach.2: Teaches you to spoof a door lock
neon_city.beh.teach.2.res: One more door in this city opens for you.
neon_city.beh.teach.3: Walks you through a black-ice crawl
neon_city.beh.teach.3.res: You survived a crawl that eats the careless.
neon_city.beh.train.1: Spars with you in the stairwell
neon_city.beh.train.1.res: Your hands got faster than your fear.
neon_city.beh.train.3: Trains you to take a hit
neon_city.beh.train.3.res: You learned to stay standing after the first blow.
neon_city.beh.warn.1: Warns you a drone is scanning the block
neon_city.beh.warn.1.res: You were off the street before the sweep.
neon_city.beh.warn.2: Warns you the Spire flagged your ID
neon_city.beh.warn.2.res: You burned the badge before it burned you.
neon_city.beh.warn.3: Tells you to drop a hot contract
neon_city.beh.warn.3.res: You walked away from a job that killed its next taker.
neon_city.beh.gift.1: Anonymously couriers you an encrypted chip
neon_city.beh.gift.1.res: You received a secret with no name on it.
neon_city.beh.gift.2: Leaves a fresh optic in your locker
neon_city.beh.gift.2.res: You saw the city a little sharper after that.
neon_city.beh.gift.3: Gives you a burner deck with no history
neon_city.beh.gift.3.res: A clean deck, and a clean start, if you want one.
neon_city.beh.song.1: Hums a static lullaby from the analog days
neon_city.beh.song.1.res: The old tune slowed your pulse toward sleep.
neon_city.beh.song.2: Plays you a bootleg track off the dead net
neon_city.beh.song.2.res: A song nobody has the rights to made you feel rich.
neon_city.beh.song.3: Sings a street song about the rain
neon_city.beh.song.3.res: The song about rain made you laugh at the weather.
neon_city.beh.rest.1: Lets you crash on their floor
neon_city.beh.rest.1.res: You slept on a floor that was not yours, and were safe.
neon_city.beh.rest.2: Kills the ads on the wall so you can sleep
neon_city.beh.rest.2.res: The wall went dark and you slept like the lights were off.
neon_city.beh.rest.3: Watches the door while you sleep
neon_city.beh.rest.3.res: You slept without one ear on the door.
neon_city.beh.debt.1: Borrows credits and swears to repay
neon_city.beh.debt.1.res: Your account grew lighter and your patience shorter.
neon_city.beh.debt.2: Asks you to cover their clinic tab
neon_city.beh.debt.2.res: You paid for someone else's body.
neon_city.beh.debt.3: Dumps a crippling debt in your name
neon_city.beh.debt.3.res: A debt with your name on it went somewhere and did not come back.
neon_city.beh.rumor.1: Spreads word you inform for the Spire
neon_city.beh.rumor.1.res: The word followed you through three districts.
neon_city.beh.rumor.2: Whispers that your chrome is secondhand
neon_city.beh.rumor.2.res: Someone made your body a joke behind your back.
neon_city.beh.rumor.3: Sends a hit piece through the district mesh
neon_city.beh.rumor.3.res: The post did numbers, and your name did not recover quickly.
neon_city.beh.taunt.1: Mocks your cheap chrome to your face
neon_city.beh.taunt.1.res: The jab landed where the plating was thinnest.
neon_city.beh.taunt.2.res: The laugh followed you home and sat down.
neon_city.beh.taunt.3: Calls you soft for keeping your old face
neon_city.beh.taunt.3.res: The insult kept you angry longer than it should have.
neon_city.beh.scheme.1: Steals your contract out from under you
neon_city.beh.scheme.1.res: Your job went to someone with faster hands and worse ethics.
neon_city.beh.scheme.2: Bricks your deck during a run
neon_city.beh.scheme.2.res: Your deck died mid-run, and you came out with nothing.
neon_city.beh.scheme.3: Reports you to the Spire for a bounty
neon_city.beh.scheme.3.res: A bounty notice with your face went up on the mesh.
neon_city.beh.upkeep.1: Tidies your rack and reseats your cables
neon_city.beh.upkeep.1.res: Your rig ran cooler without you asking why.
neon_city.beh.upkeep.2: Handles your clients while you are down
neon_city.beh.upkeep.2.res: Your work kept coming in while you could not.
neon_city.beh.upkeep.3: Puts in a word that lands you a job
neon_city.beh.upkeep.3.res: A recommendation opened a door you did not knock on.
neon_city.off.visit.1: Invites you up to their rack
neon_city.off.visit.1.text: They invite you up to their rack for a night of quiet and cheap beer, saying no business, no strings.
neon_city.off.visit.1.yes.res: You spent a night above the rain and forgot the debt for a few hours.
neon_city.off.visit.1.no.res: They said it was fine and did not invite you again soon.
neon_city.off.visit.2: Invites you to a rooftop dinner
neon_city.off.visit.2.text: They invite you to a rooftop dinner where the rain is below you and the people above you decide who gets funded.
neon_city.off.visit.2.yes.res: You ate with people who own buildings and left with a name in your pocket.
neon_city.off.visit.2.no.res: You kept the night to yourself and the roof filled without you.
neon_city.off.favor.1: Asks you to watch their back
neon_city.off.favor.1.text: They ask you to watch their back on a short run through a bad block, saying it is nothing, just a second pair of eyes.
neon_city.off.favor.1.yes.res: The run went clean because you saw the drone first, and they know it.
neon_city.off.favor.1.no.res: They went alone and came back with a scar you could have prevented.
neon_city.off.favor.2: Asks you to stand as their alibi
neon_city.off.favor.2.text: They ask you to tell the Spire investigators that they were with you all night, when everyone knows where they really were.
neon_city.off.favor.2.yes.res: Your statement held, and the lie now links your record to theirs forever.
neon_city.off.favor.2.no.res: They were charged and they understood, and the friendship cooled anyway.
neon_city.off.venture.1: Offers you a cut of a small run
neon_city.off.venture.1.text: They offer you a cut of a small data run: little risk, little payout, and a partner who has done it a hundred times.
neon_city.off.venture.1.yes.res: The run paid small and clean, which in this city is a kind of miracle.
neon_city.off.venture.1.no.res: The run paid someone else, and you kept your hands clean and your account thin.
neon_city.off.venture.2: Asks you to fund a black-market shipment
neon_city.off.venture.2.text: They ask you to fund a shipment moving through the flood tunnels, promising triple back, or nothing.
neon_city.off.venture.2.yes.res: The shipment cleared and the money tripled, and so did the attention on your account.
neon_city.off.venture.2.no.res: The shipment was seized at the mouth of the tunnel, and you kept every credit.
neon_city.off.feast.1: Calls you to a Stackblock wake
neon_city.off.feast.1.text: They call you to a wake on their floor, where the block will eat together and say the dead one's name once, out loud.
neon_city.off.feast.1.yes.res: You ate in a corridor full of neighbors and remembered why you stay in this block.
neon_city.off.feast.1.no.res: You stayed home, and the block noticed the empty chair.
neon_city.off.feast.2: Invites you to a Spire charity dinner
neon_city.off.feast.2.text: They invite you to a Spire charity dinner where the poor are served by the people who made them poor.
neon_city.off.feast.2.yes.res: You held a seat at the long table and were photographed doing it.
neon_city.off.feast.2.no.res: You kept your appetite and your dignity, and lost the introductions.
neon_city.off.secret.1: Wants to tell you who they really are
neon_city.off.secret.1.text: They want to tell you who they really are, under the name and the face, saying that once you know you will understand everything.
neon_city.off.secret.1.yes.res: You learned a truth that changes what their silence has been costing.
neon_city.off.secret.1.no.res: They respected your answer and something between you stayed closed.
neon_city.off.secret.2: Wants to hand you a memory shard
neon_city.off.secret.2.text: They want to hand you a memory shard and make you promise never to view it while they are alive.
neon_city.off.secret.2.yes.res: A shard now sits in your drawer and hums at night.
neon_city.off.secret.2.no.res: They put the shard away and never showed it to anyone else.
neon_city.off.duel.1.text: They challenge you to a deck-off in the open, saying the loser buys noodles and the winner buys the story.
neon_city.off.duel.1.yes.res: You lost narrowly and paid for noodles, and both of you got better at the game.
neon_city.off.duel.1.no.res: They took the win unearned and did not let you forget it.
neon_city.off.duel.2.text: They stake their reputation against yours in the arena, where half the district will watch and all of it will remember.
neon_city.off.duel.2.yes.res: You won on points, and your name rang louder through the district for a season.
neon_city.off.duel.2.no.res: The crowd called you afraid, and your standing took the hit you refused to.
neon_city.off.trade.1: Offers a fair swap at the Market
neon_city.off.trade.1.text: They offer a fair swap at the Market, part for part, no credits, no tricks.
neon_city.off.trade.1.yes.res: The swap held on both benches, and you each left with better chrome.
neon_city.off.trade.1.no.res: They traded elsewhere and your rig stayed as it was.
neon_city.off.trade.2: Offers a rare implant for your record
neon_city.off.trade.2.text: They offer a rare implant for the clean record you have spent years keeping, saying each of you needs the other's thing.
neon_city.off.trade.2.yes.res: You got the implant, and someone else now carries your clean history.
neon_city.off.trade.2.no.res: You kept your record and watched the implant go to a worse hand.
neon_city.off.journey.1: Asks you along on a courier run
neon_city.off.journey.1.text: They ask you along on a courier run across the roofs, one night, one package, one person who knows the route.
neon_city.off.journey.1.yes.res: You crossed three towers in the rain and saw the city from above.
neon_city.off.journey.1.no.res: They ran it alone and you envied them the height all week.
neon_city.off.journey.2: Asks you to ride the Spine to the end
neon_city.off.journey.2.text: They ask you to ride the Spine with them to the last station and see what is actually out there.
neon_city.off.journey.2.yes.res: The last station was half-flooded and full of people who chose it, and you understood them a little.
neon_city.off.journey.2.no.res: You stayed and finished an old job, and they came back different and did not explain.
neon_city.plugin.desc: How the street treats you: favors, debts, patrols, and the hidden scores the Directorate never publishes.
